content.title: Who is Cameron Young? What to know about age, wife and career earnings
content.text: April 12, 2026, 1:45 p.m. ETCameron Young entered the final round at Augusta tied with 2025 champion Rory McIlroy at 11-under par, looking to win this year's Masters for the first time. This is his fifth time at the Augusta National.With just two PGA titles, not including being 2022 Rookie of the Year, earning a green jacket would be a major milestone for Young.What is Cameron Young's age?Young was born on May 7, 1997 making him 28 years old.Where is Cameron Young from?Young was born in Scarborough, NY and lives in Jupiter, FL. He played college golf at Wake Forest.How many PGA Tour competitions has Cameron Young won?Young won the Wyndham Championship in 2025 and the Players Championship in 2026. He has seven runner-up finishes, including the 2022 Open Championship. He finished T-3 at the 2022 PGA Championship and T-4 at last year's US Open. His best Masters finish is T-7 in 2023.How much is Cameron Young worth?Young has earned a total of $31,232,516 over the course of his career. This doesn't include this year's Masters winnings. His overall net worth has been estimated around $17 and $18 million, depending on the source.Who is Cameron Young's wife?Young's wife is Kelsey Dalition. The two knew each other in Garrison, NY and started dating during their studies at Wake Forest University. They got married in 2021.Does Cameron Young have any children?Young and Dalition have two sons, Henry and John, and one daughter, Vivienne.Is Cameron Young Catholic?Young and his family are practicing Catholics, with the golfer on record saying they find a mass to go to whenever they are on the road.Cameron Young's odds of winning Masters 2026BetMGM gave Young the second best odds going into the final round at +240. McIlroy has the best odds at +160.Miguel Legoas is a Deep South Connect Team Reporter for USA Today. Find him on Instagram @miguelegoas and email atmlegoas@gannett.com.
